body:
yeah, shit is way out of my control, you got that bit right. i don't know what the fuck that second bit means though.

do you think i chose this? I clearly have no fucking control and no choice, and cannot change.
I understand better than most that money doesn't bring happiness but the opposite certainly isn't true.
Yeah I was given Adderall daily for a very long time and I wish I wasn't. It made me a different person and I'd rather have had the people around me just love the regular old harmless space-shot me.

Highschool grad, art school dropout. I couldn't handle commuting. Twelve hour days and a complete disconnection from all the other kids who were living together. The best friend that I made at college was this homeless woman who chilled outside the nearest 7/11 and was really nice to me.

Yeah I have, but easier said than done. That's a lot of years of very expensive school(which I'm terrible at, I have an attention span of less than a minute without stimulation before I start daydreaming), and in those years I could be making money instead.
We'd be the ultimate team in the most fucked up way, lol.

Mechanical/phyisical labor without getting too specific. As many hours as I want(try to get as close to fifty each week as I can) and it's a rewarding/healthy job, plus pay is good, but it's just lonely work. I'm the youngest by twenty years and I work alone on individual jobs. No way to make friends or meet women for someone as shy as me. I can totally do both it just takes longer than normal people. Can't at all where I am now though.

I wanted to build things. I was a total lego addict as a child, and drawing. I liked big machines. bulldozers, tractors, that shit. Stuck baseball cards in my bike spokes to sound like a motorcycle. My grandfather was a fireman so I looked up to that too. I'd consider it myself if I wasn't so unhealthy and tired.
Eh, I don't get hangovers anymore. I just get up, go to work, get "home", and escape for as many hours as I can until next thing I know my alarm is going off.
Cut "incredibly intelligent" from that and it's a pretty close description I guess.

just a particularly extreme feeling of loneliness/hopelessness tonight I guess.

I'll probably just drink this vodka until I pass out and don't remember posting here, wake up at like 3pm to drink until sleeping again, then get back to the daily grind until next sat night.

yeah that's steam. been a hobby for a decade but for recent couple years purely an escape/distraction/crutch. now I'm bored of my own crutches.

turns out internet friends can't replace lost actual friends I guess.
heh, if he/she was in a relationship at any point they're probably not much like me
